[DAY5 20:07:02 - DAY5 20:07:29]
I see everyone eating hamburgers at the table. I sort through trash on the desk and keep organizing. I watch Jack drink a beverage. "Hmm," I say. I move the fruit to one side and set it aside and notice many cups. Tasha: "I used to eat at that dumb student place in Shanghai." Tasha: "Isn't it the China headquarters?" Tasha: "I ate McDonald's every day." Tasha: "One year, it made me puke." Tasha: "I don't want to eat it at all." "Is it this kind?" I ask Jack. "It's the same," I say. I notice one more bag of chips with only one bite left.

[DAY6 10:51:30 - DAY6 10:52:00]
Tasha: "Nobody asked me." Tasha steps toward Nicous. Tasha: "I also brought stomach medicine." Nicous comes to our side. Tasha: "I even dropped my digestive tablets." We walk forward. Tasha: "I'm afraid we ate too much." A black car is on my left. I glance at Nicous; he turns around and I look back. We continue walking. "After meeting you, I basically need to drink 8 every day." I make a brief gesture with my right hand. Tasha: "I thought you were eating." Tasha: "I figured I'd eat without waiting for you." A manhole cover is to my left and a green space is to my right. "Just buy it." I glance right at Tasha and Nicous, then look ahead.

[DAY4 21:35:32 - DAY4 21:36:00]
Tasha puts the trash on the table. I pick up the bag on the table and inspect it. I see her still washing and stand next to her. "Eat bread," I say. She finishes washing, puts the food in her mouth, and eats it. She walks to the refrigerator and opens it; I hold the refrigerator door for her. She looks around and takes out a box of mangoes. "Oh, you're still alive," I say. I ask her to pass a mango to me and inspect it, deciding it's still good. I hold a mango and walk toward the kitchen. "Just leave it, we'll clean it up tonight," I say. I put the mango on the kitchen table.
